occupations.title: Software Developers
occupations.description: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs. Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis.
tasks: Analyze user needs and software requirements
Design and develop software systems using scientific analysis
Test and maintain software to ensure adequate performance
Collaborate with engineers and other developers
Consult with customers about software system design
Store, retrieve, and manipulate data for analysis

occupations.title: Computer Programmers
occupations.description: Create, modify, and test the code and scripts that allow computer applications to run. Work from specifications drawn up by software and web developers or other individuals.
tasks: Correct errors by making appropriate changes and rechecking the program
Perform or direct revision, repair, or expansion of existing programs
Write, update, and maintain computer programs or software packages
Consult with managerial, engineering, and technical personnel
Write or contribute to instructions or manuals to help users

occupations.title: Computer Systems Analysts
occupations.description: Analyze science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to develop and implement solutions to complex applications problems. Improve existing computer systems and review computer system capabilities.
tasks: Provide staff and users with assistance solving computer-related problems
Test, maintain, and monitor computer programs and systems
Assess the usefulness of pre-developed application packages
Analyze information to determine, recommend, and plan system installations
Define the goals of the system and devise flow charts and diagrams

occupations.title: Data Scientists
occupations.description: Develop and implement a set of techniques or analytics applications to transform raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented programming languages and visualization software.
tasks: Apply mathematical or statistical theory and methods to collect, organize, and interpret data
Develop data collection instruments, formats, and procedures
Identify data sets that can answer research questions
Communicate findings with technical and non-technical audiences
Build predictive and classification models
Develop data pipelines and ETL processes

occupations.title: Network and Computer Systems Administrators
occupations.description: Install, configure, and maintain an organization's local area network (LAN), wide area network (WAN), data communications network, operating systems, and physical and virtual servers.
tasks: Monitor network performance to determine whether adjustments need to be made
Perform data backups and disaster recovery operations
Install and support LANs, WANs, network segments, internet, and intranet systems
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, or network problems
Maintain and administer computer networks and related computing environments

occupations.title: Computer Network Support Specialists
occupations.description: Analyze, test, troubleshoot, and evaluate existing network systems, such as local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), and Internet systems or a segment of a network system.
tasks: Test and evaluate hardware and software to determine efficiency and compatibility
Set up equipment for employee use, performing installation of hardware and software
Resolve user problems and answer questions about network use
Configure systems and applications and coordinate installation of network components
Document network problems and resolutions for future reference

occupations.title: Computer Hardware Engineers
occupations.description: Research, design, develop, or test computer or computer-related equipment for commercial, industrial, military, or scientific use. May supervise the manufacturing and installation of computer or computer-related equipment and components.
tasks: Design, build, or test computer or computer-related equipment
Analyze information to determine, recommend, and plan layout
Evaluate factors such as reporting formats required and speed of equipment operation
Test and verify hardware and support peripherals to ensure meeting specifications
Update knowledge and skills to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology

occupations.title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
occupations.description: Research conditions in local, regional, national, or online markets. Gather information to determine potential sales of a product or service, or plan a marketing or advertising campaign.
tasks: Collect and analyse data on customer demographics and preferences
Prepare reports of findings, including data and graphs
Measure and assess customer and employee satisfaction
Seek and provide information to help companies determine their position in the marketplace
Devise and evaluate methods and procedures for collecting data

occupations.title: Accountants and Auditors
occupations.description: Examine, analyze, and interpret accounting records to prepare financial statements, give advice, or audit and evaluate statements prepared by others. Install or advise on systems of recording costs or other financial and budgetary data.
tasks: Prepare, examine, or analyse accounting records, financial statements
Establish tables of accounts and assign entries to proper accounts
Develop, implement, modify, and document record-keeping systems
Compute taxes owed and prepare tax returns
Advise management about issues such as resource utilisation and tax strategies

occupations.title: Business Intelligence Analysts
occupations.description: Produce financial and market intelligence by querying data repositories and generating periodic reports. Devise methods for identifying data patterns and trends in available information sources.
tasks: Synthesise current business intelligence data to produce reports
Analyse competitive market strategies through analysis of related product and market trends
Create or maintain business intelligence tools or systems
Identify or monitor current and potential customers using business intelligence tools
Conduct or coordinate tests to ensure that intelligence is consistent with defined needs
